biggest_catch: You only get paid if your friend registers through your referral link, opens a new Arvest checking account, and within 60 days does BOTH: (1) a direct deposit, automatic payment, or recurring debit card transaction AND (2) eight posted debit card purchases. A friend who opens the account but never uses the debit card earns you nothing.
catches: Referred friend must register via the referrer's link, open a new qualified Arvest Bank checking account within 180 days of the referral registration, and within 60 days of account opening complete: (a) a direct deposit OR automatic payment OR recurring debit card transaction, AND (b) eight debit card purchases that post during the 60-day period (pending transactions do not count; ATM transactions excluded).
Referrer capped at five (5) Reward Cards ($250 value) per calendar year.
Reward Card delivered 4-6 weeks after all requirements are completed.
Arvest associates are not eligible to participate. Only one referrer may earn per referred person (first referral registration counts).
Rewards may be reported as income to the IRS; consult a tax advisor.
Program may be discontinued or changed at any time without notice.

steps: Register for the Arvest ReferLive program and share your referral link or media with friends and family.
Your friend registers for the offer using your referral link.
Your friend opens a new qualified Arvest Bank checking account within 180 days of the referral registration.
Within 60 days of account opening, your friend completes a direct deposit, automatic payment, or recurring debit card transaction AND makes eight posted debit card purchases.
Your $50 Visa Reward Card is delivered 4-6 weeks after all requirements are completed.
